render_arraystructures: render ArraySpec and Wildcard shapecheck structures as foldable treescope tree nodes with labeled summaries
summarize_arraystructure: summarize an ArraySpec by displaying its dtype, positional dimensions with variables, and named shape annotations
wrap_dimvar: wrap a dimension variable string with cyan italic CSS styling for treescope tree rendering
render_wildcard_nodes: render shapecheck.Wildcard nodes as one-line treescope tree entries with optional description labels
